evidence_matrix.name: no_confidence_filtering
evidence_matrix.finding: Confidence filtering yielded deltas of only +0.01 to +0.08 pp vs unfiltered baseline (C=0.0), failing the +1.0 pp promotion threshold. Unfiltered Tent in E8 matches thresholded CoTTA.

evidence_matrix.name: no_consistency
evidence_matrix.finding: Multi-view consistency yielded Macro F1 deltas of -0.05 to +0.02 pp vs clean baseline. In E8, 10-view CoTTA (0.5820) showed no improvement over single-view Tent (0.5824).

evidence_matrix.name: no_anchor
evidence_matrix.finding: Source anchor regularization achieved at best +0.05 pp vs unanchored AdaBN baseline (lambda=0.0). Formally rejected as a beneficial component in E3.3.

evidence_matrix.name: no_temporal_null_evidence
evidence_matrix.finding: Temporal risk scores inverted across seeds (AUROC 1.000 on Seed 0 to 0.000 on Seed 1). Offered zero stable benefit over generic adaptation signals.

evidence_matrix.name: no_controller
evidence_matrix.finding: Gate E failed Criteria 2, 3, 6. Branch C operates unconditionally with NO controller. The 69-stream E8 matrix is itself the empirical characterization of unconditional TTA.

evidence_matrix.name: generic_protection_substituted
evidence_matrix.finding: All generic vision TTA methods fail to beat source_only (Macro F1 0.5906 vs CoTTA 0.5820, Tent 0.5824, SAR 0.5801, AdaBN 0.5793). Generic vision protection does not prevent degradation under SAR distribution shifts.

evidence_matrix.name: normalization_control
evidence_matrix.finding: Switching from frozen source stats (0.5906) to batch stats (0.5793) accounts for the entire degradation observed in TTA baselines. Bounded diagnostic needed to test intermediate running-statistics momentum without parameter updates.

evidence_matrix.name: reject_update_only_vs_source_fallback
evidence_matrix.finding: Not applicable because no adaptive controller or policy was approved or retained under Branch C. Fabricating a policy gate to compare fallback modes is prohibited.

evidence_matrix.name: matched_acceptance_calibration_budget
evidence_matrix.finding: Not applicable because no policy was retained under Branch C. Raw signal comparisons are documented in E5.

evidence_matrix.name: cotta_component_diagnosis
evidence_matrix.finding: Full CoTTA yields only +0.0028 Macro F1 over unadapted BN control. Specific incremental contributions of stochastic restoration and teacher EMA remain unisolated.
